entities.name: Johann Georg Wirsung
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Georg Wirsung was a German anatomist who was a long-time prosector in Padua. He is credited with discovering the pancreatic duct in humans. He was assassinated due to a professional rivalry by another physician.
